ExtensionManifest.Name: Remote Diagnostics Toolkit
ExtensionManifest.Author: ConnectWise Labs
ExtensionManifest.ShortDescription: Add additional tabs on the Host page to view and manage a device's processes, software, event log, services, updates, and users. Requires 22.9+

Setting.Name: EventLogRequestCount
Setting.Description: The number of Entries requested from the Event Log (or similar system). Limited to less than 100.
